Definition: from G575 and the base of G2425; to go (i.e. spread) forth (by rumor):--come abroad.
BiblicalUsage: To come abroad, to spread by report — Paul's joy that the Romans' obedience has come abroad unto all men, and his wish that they be wise unto good and simple concerning evil. One verse, and a whole church's reputation in it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a church's obedience speaks further than its preaching, and Rome's had travelled everywhere.
